review_method: Compare every candidate title, mission surface, hypothesis, null or failure condition, source need, artifact set, falsifier, rollback, protected gate, expected disposition, and novelty statement against all 120 frozen records and their originating preregistrations; require a mechanism-level delta rather than synonym replacement.

checks.semantic_delta: Moves from support-set, dependency, publication, and citation-entailment checks to bidirectional requirement-evidence coverage with quarantine for post-hoc orphan artifacts.
Separates kinetic-Hessian rank, signature, degeneracy, constraint count, rank jumps, and strong-coupling warnings from conservation, units, and principal-symbol hyperbolicity.
Targets instrument-calibration covariance provenance and shared-nuisance double counting rather than selection functions, schema round trips, or prior sensitivity.
Adds participant-safety events, withdrawal protection, arm-independent stopping, and ethics-review reservation rather than allocation, dropout analysis locks, or scorer reliability.
Tests operation-specific verification relationships and controller scope against confused-deputy use rather than assurance composition, cross-layer coherence, or key-rotation races.

Centers wording-version change control and mandate-scope non-substitution while refusing to synthesize Māori wording or authority; prior work centered consent chronology, authority sunset, data governance, dissent, and recusal.
Budgets credential-status timing and batch correlation across cache partitions rather than selective-disclosure linkage, status interoperability, or resolver-request metadata.
Uses systematic recipe-step ablation and hidden-state causality checks rather than generic environment parity, external handoff structure, or clock-locale determinism.
Enforces individual-versus-group analysis levels and ecological, atomistic, and Simpson-reversal barriers rather than construct validity, entropy-domain separation, or measurement-scale arithmetic.
Prohibits relabeling one evidence class as another and technical substitution for external authority, distinct from dependency cut sets, freshness withdrawal, and compensatory scoring.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first bounded read of the required family-index skill exceeded a 10-second command wrapper before returning content.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Inspected the small file metadata and completed the full read with a 30-second wrapper before repository actions.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A broad hidden-file search for the chosen identity exceeded the bounded command wrapper.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Used branch, live-remote ref, worktree registration, source-tree, and target-path checks; every scoped collision check was zero.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: An AGENTS.md discovery command returned the expected no-match exit code, which the outer command wrapper surfaced as a failure.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Checked each applicable ancestor and repository path directly; no AGENTS.md file applied.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The single authorized additive worktree command exceeded the 60-second wrapper during the large checkout.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Did not retry. Audited the one materialized worktree and found the exact source head, intended unique branch, clean status, valid registration, and no residual Git process.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A broad recursive proposal-file content search exceeded its bounded wrapper.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Switched to Git tree path enumeration and read the canonical frozen 120-record index plus originating preregistrations.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A read-only PowerShell file-inspection wrapper had one missing closing parenthesis and exited before reading files.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Corrected only the wrapper syntax and completed the intended read; repository content was unchanged by the failed invocation.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first complete repository-suite invocation exceeded a 60-second command wrapper before returning a result.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Confirmed no residual test process, reran the identical suite with a longer wrapper, and observed 250 tests pass with zero failures, errors, or skips.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first supplemental staged secret scan used an unbounded sk- token pattern and matched ordinary family-index names containing risk- or task-.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Kept the staged review failed, classified the five benign matches, and replaced the supplemental pattern with a boundary-aware token rule before rerunning the complete staged scan.

boundary: Semantic distinctness is a preregistration review result, not proof that the proposals are scientifically true, externally novel, authorized, completed, or production-ready.
